title: Time Jump: Scenario Time 09:30, Crest Approaching

fields.scenarioTitle: Ninety Minutes — Flash Flood, Evacuation & Campus Shelter
fields.narration: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. The exercise clock now reads 08:30 EDT, Thursday, March 25, 2027. This is Crest and Return. From this card on, the SimCell runs scenario time ahead of the room clock. Each inject carries its own scenario time: first the crest near 10:30, then the Thursday-afternoon recovery. The first injects are at scenario time 09:30, and the SimCell will tell you when scenario time moves to the afternoon. At scenario time 09:30 the creek has climbed past 9.0 feet. The Mill Street gauge reads 9.71 feet and is still rising. The Dairy Lane crossing is under water. Lot C is flooding past its 9.5-foot stage, and water covers the Lower Quad paths. The 0720 AM Ohio River Forecast Center issuance is still the latest forecast: 10.5 feet near 10 AM, crest 10.8 feet near 10:30 AM. Riverside's evacuation, the Kessler Fieldhouse shelter, the Lot C move and the library move stand as you left them. Kessler registration keeps climbing as Sugar Run Apartments residents, commuters stranded by Lot C and students from Lower Quad buildings arrive. The parent line at (740-555-0150 has more than 150 voicemails nobody has listened to. Whatever you ordered stays in force. Anything you have not decided is still undecided.
worldState: Scenario time is 09:30 EDT, Thursday, March 25, 2027. The room clock reads 08:30. Every SimCell inject from here on is stamped with its scenario time.

Mill Street culvert gauge: 9.71 ft at 09:30, TREND RISING. It is above flood stage (7.0) and the Dairy Lane closure stage (6.5), and well past the 8.0 ft level where the Dairy Lane crossing goes under.

Latest forecast: Ohio River Forecast Center issuance of 0720 AM. 10.5 ft near 10 AM, CREST 10.8 ft near 10:30 AM, then falling slowly in the afternoon. The next issuance is due by 0900 AM and has not reached room 108.
The Dairy Lane crossing is under water and impassable. Marlowe Fire and the diesel tanker are on whatever routes you gave them.
Lot C is flooding beyond its 9.5 ft stage. Any truck or generator still in the lot is standing in water.
Water covers the Lower Quad paths. Nobody can walk across the Lower Quad.
Riverside: the evacuation, the elevator and main-breaker decisions, and the access-list residents are where your last orders left them.
Kessler Fieldhouse is OPEN and registration is still climbing. New arrivals are Sugar Run Apartments residents, commuters stranded by Lot C, and students from Lower Quad buildings.
Parent line (740-555-0150: more than 150 unheard voicemails.
Whitcomb Library: the network room and Special Collections move stands as you ordered it. The lower level floods only if the creek reaches 12.0 ft. That is not the current forecast.
Every order already given stays in force. Anything not decided is still undecided.
fields.facilitatorNote: Phase 2 opens on this card (ESRSRP section 3). Make sure the projector shows both the room clock and scenario time 09:30. The Riverside vault electrician's 09:15 deadline has passed in scenario time. If Fac never confirmed elevators empty, have the SimCell report that the breaker was pulled at 09:15 and the elevators are stopped. Watch for each seat updating to the 9.71 ft stage and the 0720 AM forecast, and for the PIO keeping the 30-minute update cycle (MENSO section 5).

instructorNote: This card resets everyone's picture to scenario time 09:30 for the crest phase. Watch whether the IC confirms Level 1 Full and logs the time and the basis (the 0720 AM forecast). Fac should check the Lot C and library moves against the 9.5 and 10.5 ft stages, DoS should start reconciling the Kessler count against the Riverside roster, and the PIO should keep the 30-minute updates going and put staff on the parent line.
